verdict.rationale: Index tuning is a fair question for a vector database like Weaviate, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents HNSW parameters (such as ef, efConstruction or maxConnections), alternative index types, or any recall/latency/memory trade-off controls. The only mention is that Weaviate stores vectors and inverted indexes, which says nothing about tuning them.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can tune index parameters (HNSW graph settings, index types) to trade recall against latency and memory
